name: Titanium Monitor
notes:
- The last disk analysis is kept between launches: the Storage section shows it again, with its date, until you analyze again. Moving items to the Trash or uninstalling apps needs a fresh analysis, and the section says so. "Forget Everything" deletes the saved analysis.
- The disk card in the popover shows how much space caches, logs and files Xcode rebuilds take, according to the last analysis and when it ran; without an analysis it says how to find out. It is always one line, so the popover keeps its height.
- A new version shows in the menu bar: a dot on the icon until it is installed, skipped or postponed, and a notification when the daily check finds it (once per version, can be turned off in the Updates pane). A click on the notification or on the popover row opens Settings on Updates.
